name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Controlled page navigation with current-page and previous/next semantics.

files.content:
<button
  type="button"
  [disabled]="page() <= 1"
  aria-label="Previous page"
  (click)="select(page() - 1)"
>
  Previous
</button>
@for (item of pages(); track item) {
  <button
    type="button"
    [attr.aria-current]="item === page() ? 'page' : null"
    [attr.aria-label]="'Page ' + item"
    (click)="select(item)"
  >
    {{ item }}
  </button>
}
<button
  type="button"
  [disabled]="page() >= totalPages()"
  aria-label="Next page"
  (click)="select(page() + 1)"
>
  Next
</button>
